name: New Year's Eve in the City at Elizabeth Quay
venue: Elizabeth Quay, Barrack Square & Supreme Court Gardens
includes: 8:30pm family fireworks and midnight fireworks over the Swan River
Free carnival rides in the Lotterywest Family Fun Zone (2025)
Floating-stage DJs, roving performers and circus acts
Food trucks across the riverside zones
Accessible paths, toilets, Auslan interpreters and sensory spaces (2025)
blurb: The City of Perth's free riverside celebration and the city's main fireworks. Around 130,000 people came in 2025. The event zone is alcohol-free, and the 2026 program is still to be announced.

name: 6HEAD New Year's Eve at Elizabeth Quay
time: Evening; check sitting times with the venue
includes: Three-course menu by Chef Sean Hall
Beverage package with champagne
Live entertainment and DJ
Midnight countdown
Views of the Elizabeth Quay fireworks
blurb: A premium steakhouse right on Elizabeth Quay, with drinks included and a table facing the river fireworks. Pricing for NYE 2026 is already published.

name: The Reveley NYE at Elizabeth Quay
includes: Four-course set menu: canapé, shared entrée, choice of main, shared dessert
Optional Chandon or Moët drinks packages
Front-row position for the Elizabeth Quay fireworks
blurb: A riverside bar on Elizabeth Quay with one of the best-value fireworks dinners in the city. Pick an early sitting with kids or a late one for the midnight show.

name: Twilight to Midnight at The Island
venue: The Island, 1 Valdura Pl, Elizabeth Quay
price_text: $35pp; kids 12 and under free (2025 price, TBC)
includes: Early session 4–6pm with no ticket needed
Island Countdown for kids, 6–8:30pm
Midnight on Island Time party from 9pm
À la carte dining, drinks and wood-fired pizza until midnight
Live entertainment
blurb: A waterside restaurant and microbrewery on the island in the middle of Elizabeth Quay, about as close to the fireworks as a ticket gets.

name: C Restaurant NYE: Revolving Dinner on Level 33
venue: C Restaurant, Level 33, 44 St Georges Terrace
price_text: $195 early sitting or $315 late sitting (2025 prices, TBC)
includes: Multi-course NYE set menu
Live music
Perth's only revolving restaurant, 33 floors up
Late sitting runs through the midnight countdown
blurb: Watch the whole city turn beneath you on Perth's revolving restaurant, with a cheaper early sitting or a late one that takes you into 2027.

name: Hearth NYE at The Ritz-Carlton
venue: Hearth, The Ritz-Carlton Perth, 1 Barrack St
time: Evening; check sitting times with the venue
includes: Six-course WA tasting menu (2025: Southwest marron, dry-aged Wagin duck)
Champagne on arrival
Songbird rooftop bar in the same hotel also runs an NYE party
blurb: A polished WA produce degustation at the Ritz-Carlton on Elizabeth Quay, steps from the riverside fireworks.

name: Wildflower NYE at State Buildings
venue: Wildflower, State Buildings, cnr St Georges Tce & Barrack St
price_text: From $195pp, four or six courses (2025 price, TBC)
includes: Four or six-course seasonal set menu
Drinks on the Wildflower terrace
State Buildings runs seven venues on NYE, open until 1:30am
blurb: Fine dining on the rooftop level of the heritage State Buildings, a five-minute walk from the riverside fireworks.

name: NYE at Petition, Long Chim & Post
venue: State Buildings, cnr St Georges Tce & Barrack St
price_text: From $135pp adults, $60 kids; Post $155 (2025 prices, TBC)
includes: Three-course festive menus at Petition, Wine Merchant and Long Chim
Four-course Italian dinner at Post
Kids' pricing at most venues
Bars open late in the State Buildings
blurb: The more relaxed State Buildings options: Thai at Long Chim, modern bistro at Petition and Italian at Post, with kids' menus for an early family dinner.

name: Fraser's NYE Dinner in Kings Park
venue: Fraser's Restaurant, 60 Fraser Ave, Kings Park
includes: Shared plates and king prawn risotto
Choice of Goldband snapper, Black Angus fillet or pork cutlet
Dessert
Live band from 6:30pm
Add-ons: oysters, WA rock lobster salad, Moët
fireworks: City & river views; fireworks view varies
blurb: A classic Perth NYE dinner with the city skyline laid out below Kings Park. NYE 2026 menu and pricing are already published.

name: New Year's Eve at Crown Perth
price_text: Crystal Club from $345; NYE Gala $395 (2025 prices, TBC)
includes: Crystal Club NYE event with sweeping views
2025 Gala: three-course menu, unlimited Moët and live bands
NYE menus at Nobu, Bistro Guillaume, Modo Mio, Silks and more
blurb: Perth's biggest all-in-one NYE venue: a gala, a club party and a dozen restaurants under one roof in Burswood.

name: NYE at QT Perth: Santini & the Rooftop
price_text: Santini from $149; rooftop party from $249 (2025 prices, TBC)
includes: Five-course Italian menu at Santini Bar & Grill (2025)
Late seating includes rooftop access
Rooftop party with free-flowing drinks, canapés and DJs
blurb: Candlelit Italian downstairs and a themed party on one of the CBD's best-known rooftops, so you can do dinner and dancing in one booking.

name: The Aviary Neon Jungle NYE
includes: Three hours of bubbles, house wine and tap beer
Food stations
DJs, UV paint and neon styling
blurb: A CBD rooftop turned into a glowing jungle party, with a drinks package covering the run-up to midnight.

name: Lil's Rooftop NYE
includes: Two hours of free-flowing wine, sparkling and beer
DJs
Cheese wheel pasta
blurb: A Med-style rooftop in the West End with a short, cheap drinks session that ends in time to walk down for the midnight fireworks.

name: Market Grounds NYE Night Market Party
price_text: GA $20 incl. a drink; VIP $89 (2025 prices, TBC)
includes: Entry drink with GA
VIP: three hours of drinks, roaming canapés and upper-level access
DJs, fire dancers and cage dancers
blurb: A big, easy CBD beer garden party with a $20 door price and a VIP upgrade if you want the drinks covered.

name: LEVELS NYE at Stories, Yagan Square
includes: Three levels and four zones
Rooftop silent disco
Multiple bars across the five-storey venue
blurb: A multi-level block party inside the new Stories precinct at Yagan Square, one of the cheapest big-venue tickets in the city.

name: Garbage NYE at The Rechabite
includes: Three stages from the basement to the rooftop
Laneway and front-yard spaces
DJs all night
blurb: A heritage Northbridge hall taken over by a three-stage party, from the basement right up to the rooftop.

name: Leederville NYE Block Party
price_text: From $49 entry; dinner packages from $130 (2025 prices, TBC)

Venues include The Leederville Hotel, Servo, The Garden, Duende and Lima Cantina
Optional set-menu and drinks packages that include entry
blurb: One wristband for a whole precinct of bars, with dinner packages if you want a table before the party starts.

name: Si Paradiso NYE Dinner & Courtyard Party
price_text: Courtyard party from about $50–$60; dinner party about $125 (2025 prices, TBC)
includes: Italian set menu with local seafood, pizzas and desserts
Wine, magnums and cocktails
Courtyard dance party with DJs
blurb: Beaufort Street's favourite Italian party room: a long dinner followed by a courtyard party that runs well past midnight.

name: The Court NYE Party
includes: Drag shows
Balloon drops and confetti cannons
Pop DJs across the decades
blurb: Perth's best-known LGBTQIA+ pub throws a loud, colourful NYE party at a price that barely registers.

name: The Camfield NYE Garden Party
price_text: Garden party $35; bottomless dinner from $75 (2025 prices, TBC)
includes: Live music from FELIX The Band and DJ Buda (2025)
Bottomless package with a three-course share menu and drinks
Riverside setting next to Optus Stadium

name: Tropical NYE at The Royal on the Waterfront
venue: The Royal on the Waterfront, 60 Royal St
includes: Tropical paradise theme
DJ and music
Midnight countdown on Claisebrook Cove
blurb: A free-entry waterfront pub party on Claisebrook Cove. Bring a Hawaiian shirt.

name: NYE at Gloucester Park
price_text: Adults $35; concession and 12–17 $20; under 12 free with ticket (2025 prices, TBC)
includes: Harness racing on the track
DJ, kids' activities, bars and food trucks
Gloucester Park's own midnight fireworks
blurb: A night at the trots with its own midnight fireworks, a short walk from the East Perth train station. No outside food is allowed.

name: SNACK NYE 2026
includes: Six stages, including a 60m Acropolis main stage
Secret headliner at midnight
Foam party, silent disco, rides and themed bars
Food trucks
Midnight countdown with flames and fireworks

name: NYE on the Beach: Port Beach Festival

includes: Four stages including a sunset beach stage
Silent disco
Six or more pop-up bars and food trucks
Countdown sparklers at midnight
blurb: A beach festival with sand between your toes and four stages, right on the coast at North Fremantle. It sold out in 2025.

name: Scarborough Beach Bar NYE
includes: Live music
Beachfront terrace
Optional two-hour bottomless cocktails, slushies, beer and wine
blurb: Ring in the new year with the Indian Ocean at your feet. Free entry, with an optional bottomless session before midnight.

name: NYE w/ Good Company
includes: Canapés during spritz hour
Shared mains, including cheese wheel pasta
Three-hour bottomless beer and wine
After 8:30pm: $15 pizzas and $15 espresso martinis

name: NYE at The Raffles, Applecross

includes: Riverside VIP package with three hours of drinks and canapés
DJs
Big lawn and terrace on the Swan River
blurb: The famous Art Deco pub on the Applecross foreshore, looking across the river to the city skyline.

name: Sweetwater Rooftop Masquerade NYE
venue: Sweetwater Rooftop Bar, Level 6, 1 Silas St
includes: Masquerade theme
Roaming canapés and food stations
Three hours of bubbles, wine and tap beer

name: NYE at The Left Bank
includes: Three-hour bottomless drinks, 7:30–10:30pm
2000s and 2010s DJ set
Downstairs bar and beer garden
blurb: A riverside pub party in East Fremantle with a bottomless package and throwback hits.

Downstairs: free entry
Right on Bathers Beach

name: Hotel Rottnest NYE
includes: DJ sets and a live band (2025: Feel Estate)
Beachfront lawn on Thomson Bay
Close to the island's family fireworks
blurb: The island pub party on Thomson Bay. Book your ferry or accommodation first, as both sell out.

name: NYE Family Fireworks on Rottnest Island
includes: Afternoon entertainment for families
Live music, roving acts and activities (2025 program)
Early-evening fireworks over Thomson Bay (8pm in 2025)
blurb: A free family afternoon on the island that ends with fireworks over Thomson Bay. The fireworks are free, but you still need a ferry ticket, and ferries fill up fast.

name: Captain Cook Cruises NYE Cruise
includes: Welcome drink
Buffet dinner with mains, salads and desserts
DJ and photo booth
Reserved table seating
Bar for extra drinks

name: Pirate Ship Mandurah NYE Cruise

includes: Cruise past the Mandurah canal Christmas lights
Docks to watch the 9pm fireworks
BYO beer and wine, up to four drinks each

name: Mandurah Cruises NYE Lights & Fireworks Cruise
venue: Mandjar Bay, in front of the Mandurah Performing Arts Centre
includes: Two-hour cruise on a two-storey vessel
Canal Christmas lights
9pm fireworks from the water
Licensed bar and snacks to buy
blurb: A bigger licensed boat from Mandjar Bay that combines the canal light displays with the early fireworks.

name: City of Mandurah NYE Fireworks
includes: 9pm and midnight fireworks
Outdoor movie before the early show
Smoke-free, alcohol-free and pet-free (service dogs welcome)

name: City of Rockingham New Year's Eve
venue: Churchill Park & Bell Park, Rockingham Foreshore

Live music on stage all night
Rides, face painting and kids' activities
Low-sensory zone and food vendors

name: NYE Fireworks at The Marina Mindarie

Marina restaurants and bars
Supported by the City of Wanneroo

name: Zoo Year's Eve at Perth Zoo

Live family entertainment on the Main Lawn
Kids' countdown at 7:30pm

Live music and a cash bar
